intro: Oman wraps around the south-east corner of Arabia, with mountains, deserts, green wadis and over 3,000 km of coastline.

chapters.title: Mountains and deserts
text: The Hajar Mountains run along the north; Jebel Shams is the highest peak at about 3,000 m, beside a deep canyon. The Wahiba Sands are a sea of dunes, and the Empty Quarter covers the west.
The Musandam peninsula, separated from the rest of Oman by the UAE, overlooks the Strait of Hormuz with fjord-like inlets.

chapters.title: Monsoon in Dhofar
text: In summer the khareef monsoon turns the hills around Salalah green and misty, while the rest of Arabia bakes.

keyTerms.meaning: The summer monsoon season in southern Oman.
A valley that fills with water after rain.
